title: Are Financial Statements More Comparable When GAAP Restricts Managers’ Discretion?
eligible_reason: Not a staggered binary adoption design. Main tests regress comparability on a continuous standard-restrictiveness score (dscorerr) with time-varying controls and industry-year (or firm) FE. Validation DiDs use single standards with common dates and pooled treated dummies: Table 4 SFAS 86 (software x post1, post after Dec 1986) and CECL (bank x post, Dec 2020), with industry and year FE but no firm FE; Table 5 SFAS 141 (MACT = merger in the year, post = fyear >= 2002, common), with controls.
design_notes: SAS (proc surveyreg) and Stata. Firm-pair comparability (De Franco et al.) outcomes; mediation bootstraps in Table 9.

ineligible_specs_listed.reason: single-date standards; pooled treated dummy with industry FE, no unit FE
common post date (fyear >= 2002); MACT is a time-varying merger indicator; time-varying controls

data_files_note: ReadMe.txt: replication files for every table shipped; some raw Compustat/IBES inputs not shipped.
screener_notes: Code is a mix of SAS and Stata. Not a staggered design.
